BUT the fixture response (fixtures/descript-agent.json) and likely agent guidance state 'the Descript API does not support cancelling jobs ... cannot be stopped via the API' — this is FALSE. DELETE /jobs/{job_id} returns 204 (API Reference confirms; verified live in z2v.1 check-7 cleanup; DescriptClient.cancelJob() exists). Either (a) expose a cancelJob tool, or (b) fix the justification to be truthful ('this agent doesn't expose a cancel action' not 'the API can't'). Decision needed.
acceptance_criteria: Agent no longer claims the API cannot cancel jobs; either a cancelJob tool exists or the decline reason is truthful.
close_reason: Added cancelJob tool (wraps client.cancelJob → DELETE /jobs/{id}, verified 204 in z2v.1 check-7), wired into descript agent. Corrected the false 'Descript API does not support cancelling jobs' claim in the AIMock fixture + flipped the eval case to expect cancelJob. title: Cheap default model + per-op cost docs
description: Model choice is the biggest cost lever (hector: haiku 4.5 <5cr/clip; Topher: 'auto' 40-60cr/clip). agentEdit exposes model but defaults to Underlord default (likely expensive). Set a sensible cheap default (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5) and document per-op credit costs (from Phase 3) in README so users budget. Steve Robertson's point: keep deterministic ops OFF the agentEdit/Underlord path so they cost nothing.
acceptance_criteria: Sensible cheap default model; README has a per-operation credit cost table from measured Phase 3 data.
close_reason: agentEdit now defaults model to haiku-4.5-underlord (cheapest, ~2cr measured; was Descript's expensive 'automatic'). Valid model enum documented in the tool description. README gains a 'Cost model' table (per-op: agentEdit=AI credits, import=media-sec, publish=render, reads/cancel=free). Typecheck green.

title: URL pre-validation before import
description: Fail fast (save media minutes) before submitting a bad import URL. Descript requires public/pre-signed URL with HTTP Range support + valid Content-Type (aakrokr's analysis: validator does HEAD + GET Range:0-0). Pre-flight a HEAD + Range:0-0 check in importMedia and reject with a clear message instead of burning a job. Informed by the Phase 1 metadata-repro.
acceptance_criteria: Bad/non-range/non-public URLs rejected pre-submit with a specific reason; valid URLs pass through unchanged.
close_reason: importMedia now pre-flights every media URL (validateMediaUrl: 1-byte ranged GET to the media host, zero Descript cost) and rejects non-public/non-range/non-media URLs with a specific reason before submitting — saves media minutes. skip_url_validation escape hatch added. Verified zero-spend: passes real 206 URL (test-videos.co.uk), rejects 200/no-Accept-Ranges + text/html + 401/403/404. Typecheck green.

Detect project_changed:false (job succeeded but no edit) and surface 'edit did not execute — likely awaiting plan/brief approval'. Wire any direct-execute/skip-brief flag found in Phase 3.
acceptance_criteria: project_changed:false reported as a distinct non-success outcome with actionable message; skip-brief flag wired if it exists.
close_reason: agentEdit now flags project_changed:false (status->partial + actionable 'edit did not execute, likely plan-approval stall' message) instead of false success. Agent instruction added.
